lines.trans: You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Teacher Song?
"Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago."
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
Wait—turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
And look at the pencilled note at the bottom: "Finish before Friday."
Why did the music stop thirty years ago—and who wrote it?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí bàn. Combines 一 ('one') + 半 ('half'); note yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone bàn.

examples.text: 这壶热茶我们已经喝了一半。
examples.trans: We have already drunk half of this pot of hot tea.

examples.text: 第二页乐谱有一半还没有写完。
examples.trans: Half of the second page of sheet music is still unfinished.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè pǔ. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本乐谱 ('a book of sheet music').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

related.gloss: a book of sheet music (measure word 本)

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí sì. Cardinal number twenty-four ('two tens four'); followed by a measure word before nouns.

examples.text: 一天有二十四个小时。
examples.trans: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

examples.text: 两打茶杯一共是二十四个。
examples.trans: Two dozen teacups come to twenty-four in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū. Used for fixing pipes, locks, furniture, or appliances (修好 'fix completely').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ. Read 3rd-tone qiǎ or colloquial kǎ when something gets wedged tight in a slot, hinge, or latch.

examples.text: 硬币卡在抽屉缝里，拿不出来了。
examples.trans: The coin got wedged in the drawer crack and won't come out.

examples.text: 有一张旧纸卡在木头合页后面。
examples.trans: An old sheet of paper is wedged behind the wooden hinge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

句.gloss: measure word for sentences and remarks

meanings.en: measure word for sentences and remarks
meanings.note: Pinyin: jù. Counts spoken or written sentences (一句话 'one sentence / a word').

examples.text: 先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
examples.trans: Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.

examples.text: 你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
examples.trans: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé yè. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副合页 ('a set of hinges').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 给老木门的合页上点油就不响了。
examples.trans: Put a drop of oil on the wooden door's hinges and they stop squeaking.

related.gloss: a set of hinges (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēng. Read 1st-tone hēng when softly humming a tune under one's breath (哼歌 'hum a song').

examples.text: 小美一边揉面团，一边轻轻哼着歌。
examples.trans: Mei softly hummed a tune while kneading bread dough.

examples.text: 宋老师看着旧乐谱，小声哼出了第一句。
examples.trans: Looking at the old score, Teacher Song softly hummed the opening phrase.

meanings.note: Pinyin: a. Expresses sudden realization at the start of a line, or softens warmth at the end.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo tīng. Built from 好 ('good') + 听 ('listen'); compare 好看 ('good-looking') and 好吃 ('tasty').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 你的声音真好听。
examples.trans: Your voice sounds really lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán quán. Emphasizes 100% agreement or completeness (完全正确 'completely right').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo jié. In music notation, counts bars/measures between vertical barlines (二十四小节 'twenty-four bars').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前八个小节特别轻快。
examples.trans: The opening eight bars of this waltz are especially light and lively.

examples.text: 宋老师用铅笔在第四小节旁边做了记号。
examples.trans: Teacher Song made a pencil mark beside the fourth bar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng. Colloquial action verb before result complements (弄丢 'lose', 弄湿 'get wet', 弄好 'fix up').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug right beside the bed fits just right.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn nian. Softened reduplication of 念 ('read out').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 字太小了，你帮我念念信上写的什么。
examples.trans: The print is tiny—read aloud for me what the letter says.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu xiě. Compound 手 ('hand') + 写 ('write'); frequently used before 的 to mean 'handwritten' (手写的菜单).

examples.text: 咖啡馆门口立着一块手写的木头菜单牌。
examples.trans: A handwritten wooden menu board stands by the café entrance.

examples.text: 这张手写的明信片比打印的更有温度。
examples.trans: This handwritten postcard feels much warmer than a printed one.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu zhǐ. Compound 手 ('hand') + 指 ('digit/point'). Measure word: 根 (gēn), e.g. 两根手指 ('two fingers').

examples.text: 宋老师的手指轻轻落在黑白琴键上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's fingers landed gently on the black and white piano keys.

examples.text: 墙上的油漆还没干，千万别用手指碰。
examples.trans: The paint on the wall isn't dry yet—don't touch it with your fingers.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé dié. Used as a verb ('fold up') or directly before nouns to mean 'folding / collapsible' (折叠桌, 折叠谱架).

examples.text: 这种木头折叠桌不用的时候可以靠墙收好。
examples.trans: This wooden folding table can be folded against the wall when not in use.

examples.text: 请把这张大地图顺着折痕折叠起来。
examples.trans: Please fold this large map up along the creases.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu. Describes sliding a thin sheet, drawer, or card smoothly out of a tight space (抽出来).

examples.text: 他从书架中间轻轻抽出一本旧相册。
examples.trans: He gently slid an old photo album out from the middle of the bookshelf.

examples.text: 小心一点把信纸从信封里抽出来。
examples.trans: Slide the letter paper carefully out of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuán lǜ. Musical melody or tune. Measure word: 段 (duàn, 'passage/melody').

examples.text: 这段钢琴旋律听起来既温柔又熟悉。
examples.trans: This piano melody sounds both gentle and familiar.

examples.text: 哪怕过了很多年，我还是记得那首歌的旋律。
examples.trans: Even after many years, I still remember the melody of that song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì qī. Calendar date written on a letter, ticket, or score (对比 星期 'day of the week').

examples.text: 明信片右下角写着三十年前五月的日期。
examples.trans: The bottom right corner of the postcard bears a date from May thirty years ago.

examples.text: 订车票的时候一定要看清楚出发日期。
examples.trans: Always double-check the departure date when booking train tickets.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn chá. Compound 晚 ('evening') + 茶 ('tea'): an early-evening tea gathering with light pastries.

examples.text: 三十年前，客栈每个星期五都办花园晚茶。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, the inn hosted garden evening tea every Friday.

examples.text: 晚茶时间到了，小美端出了一盘刚烤好的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: When evening tea time arrived, Mei brought out a tray of freshly baked lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǔ zi. Conversational word for an instrumental piece or song tune (second syllable neutral tone). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 这首轻快的小曲子是姑姑年轻时手写的。
examples.trans: This lively little tune was handwritten by my aunt when she was young.

examples.text: 吃完晚饭，宋老师常在阳光房弹两首曲子。
examples.trans: After dinner, Teacher Song often plays a couple of pieces in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo tí. Written title at the top of a score, article, or notice.

examples.text: 乐谱最上面用黑墨水写着一行漂亮的标题。
examples.trans: At the very top of the score, a handsome title is written in black ink.

examples.text: 看清楚通知的标题，检查时间改到星期三了。
examples.trans: Read the heading of the notice carefully—the inspection time moved to Wednesday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tao mù. Rich dark hardwood prized for upright pianos and classic furniture (note neutral-tone tao).

examples.text: 擦干净以后，老钢琴的核桃木外壳亮极了。
examples.trans: After being wiped clean, the old piano's walnut wood case gleams.

examples.text: 这张核桃木书桌已经在房间里放了四十年。
examples.trans: This walnut desk has stood in the room for forty years.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn róu. Describes a gentle melody, warm voice, or kind manner.

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的开头温柔得像春天的微风。
examples.trans: The opening of this waltz is as gentle as a spring breeze.

examples.text: 宋老师说话的声音总是很温柔。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's speaking voice is always gentle and warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng guāng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片灯光 ('warm lamplight').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.en: shine; follow/according to; take a photo
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào. Means sunlight shining in, or acting according to a plan (照着).

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 早上的阳光照进安静的书房。
examples.trans: Morning sunlight shines into the quiet study.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn gěi. Respectful verb-complement compound used in musical dedications, book inscriptions, and gifts.

examples.text: 曲谱第一行写着：“献给星期五晚茶的朋友们。”
examples.trans: The first line of the score reads: 'Dedicated to our Friday evening tea friends.'

examples.text: 她把这首歌献给了教她弹琴的老师。
examples.trans: She dedicated this song to the teacher who taught her piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pò. Describes torn paper, cracked cups, or worn-out items.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kòng bái. Note 空 is read 4th-tone kòng ('unfilled space') here, not 1st-tone kōng ('sky/hollow')!

examples.text: 曲谱第二页的下半部分还是空白的。
examples.trans: The lower half of page two of the music score is still blank.

examples.text: 请在表格右下角的空白地方签上名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name in the blank space at the bottom right of the form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老师 ('a teacher').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng mì. Measure word (量词): 勺, e.g. 一勺蜂蜜 ('a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

related.gloss: a spoonful of honey (measure word 勺)

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǔ jià. Compound 谱 ('musical score') + 架 ('stand/rack'): either a freestanding stand or a piano's hinged music rest.

examples.text: 立式钢琴的木头谱架后面藏着一张旧纸。
examples.trans: Behind the upright piano's wooden music rest hid a folded old sheet of paper.

examples.text: 宋老师把翻开的曲谱平平地放在谱架上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song placed the open music score flat on the music desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 前院种着花草，后院十分安静。
examples.trans: Flowers grow in the front yard, and the back courtyard is quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuě sōng. Literally 'snow pine' (雪 + 松); aromatic cedar wood prized for keepsake boxes that repel damp and moths.

examples.text: 那个装明信片的老盒子是用香喷喷的雪松木做的。
examples.trans: That old box holding the postcards is made of fragrant cedar wood.

examples.text: 打开雪松木盒，还能闻到淡淡的木头清香。
examples.trans: Opening the cedar box, you can still smell a faint, clean woody scent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首音乐 ('a piece of music').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 每个星期五六点！整条街的人都来这儿喝茶听音乐！
examples.trans: Every Friday at six! People from the whole street came here for tea and music!

related.gloss: a piece of music (measure word 首)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn fú. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个音符 ('a musical note').

examples.text: 安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
examples.trans: So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.

examples.text: 旧乐谱上的每一个音符都是手写的。
examples.trans: Every musical note on the vintage score was written by hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng dēng. Compound 顶 ('ceiling/top') + 灯 ('lamp'). Measure word: 盏 (zhǎn).

examples.text: 九号房的磨砂玻璃顶灯一亮，整间屋子都暖洋洋的。
examples.trans: Once Room Nine's frosted-glass ceiling lamp lights up, the whole room glows warmly.

examples.text: 睡觉以前记得关掉客厅的顶灯，只留小台灯。
examples.trans: Remember to turn off the living-room ceiling light before bed and leave just the small desk lamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi. Describes black color or no light; 灯黑了 means the lights went out.

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 天黑了，我们回去吧。
examples.trans: It's getting dark; let's head back.
